nodes.label: Product Discovery & Dev Handoff
nodes.rationale: The profile sells discovery-then-handoff as one loop: validate the problem before build, then hand engineering an unambiguous artefact. Frontend fluency is framed as the mechanism that makes the handoff lossless rather than as a separate engineering career.

nodes.label: Angular 17 + SSR front-end stack
nodes.rationale: SSR on PLP/PDP pages was chosen for technical SEO and first-load performance; Bootstrap + Tailwind are unified into one design system so marketing pages stay consistent while staying responsive.

nodes.label: Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD)
nodes.rationale: Used as the framing device for discovery: clinical staff and engineers are asked what job the user hires the product for, so problem-solution fit is decided before any build.

nodes.label: Medicine 3.0
nodes.rationale: Design intent: shift the product from displaying raw biometric numbers to preventive, actionable guidance, because raw-data display causes user fatigue and gives no reason to return daily; actionable insight is what drives retention and premium conversion.

nodes.label: Vibe Coding — AI-native rapid prototyping
nodes.rationale: Chosen to bypass engineering bottlenecks: prompt-driven full-stack building lets one PM ship production prototypes (catalogs, MVPs, dashboard logic) without queueing squad capacity, compressing validation from sprints to days.

nodes.label: B2B organisational health pivot
nodes.rationale: Consumer wearable growth was slow and costly, so the same telemetry was resold as a privacy-preserving enterprise dashboard (aggregate burnout/fatigue, geo-fence safety); the pivot opens new GTM channels and is credited with a projected 15% IRR increase.

nodes.label: Freemium gamified conversion funnel
nodes.rationale: Sensor-less free users are the acquisition pool: a gamified organic path steers them toward hardware purchase and subscription, so monetisation is designed into the journey instead of gated at the door.

nodes.label: OKR 'value window' principle
nodes.rationale: Rebuilt the OKR system around the window in which a result is actually valuable, so sprints complete ahead of estimate (reported ~20%) without added headcount; also moved delivery from person-dependent to process-dependent to remove key-person risk.

nodes.label: Wizard of Oz validation
nodes.rationale: Fake the backend, keep the user flow: validate demand for a workout mode without allocating engineering, so a weak feature can be killed early (saved ~5 sprints, cut GTM risk) instead of discovered as waste after build.

nodes.label: Disk-backed archive versioning
nodes.rationale: Server disk, not localStorage, is the source of truth so every device attached to the same server sees one archive (localStorage is only fast cache/offline). A snapshot is written only when content actually changed, so repeated saves do not create duplicate versions; deleting an archive keeps its versions for recovery. data/ is deliberately outside git because it holds personal résumé information.
